boundaries: No page capture or caller URL
Only explicitly armed synthetic dev tab
No off-LAN or Chrome extension claim
After automatic close, the phone showed a pre-existing captive.apple.com Success tab; original-tab focus restoration is not proven.
At 31.57 seconds after arm, the phone was still Home. Safari did not foreground.
The popup showed created after Safari was explicitly reopened; this does not establish whether its alarm ran while suspended or on resume.
No remote command channel, persistent background worker, off-site launch or Chrome extension proof.
nextGate: Closed as off-site launch strategy. Foreground tab recovery is viable, but adds no current benefit over the delivered page/native controls; no MCP integration.
decision: Keep the reproducible experimental source; remove the one-shot app from the personal phone. Do not ship an always-running extension or claim remote wake.
